#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>
using namespace std;
typedef long long ll;
const int MOD = 998244353;

ll modpow(ll a, ll e) {
    ll res = 1;
    a %= MOD;
    while (e) {
        if (e & 1) res = (res * a) % MOD;
        a = (a * a) % MOD;
        e >>= 1;
    }
    return res;
}

vector<int> fact, invfact;
void precompute(int n) {
    fact.resize(n+1);
    invfact.resize(n+1);
    fact[0] = 1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) fact[i] = (ll)fact[i-1] * i % MOD;
    invfact[n] = modpow(fact[n], MOD-2);
    for (int i = n-1; i >= 0; --i) invfact[i] = (ll)invfact[i+1] * (i+1) % MOD;
}

ll C(int n, int r) {
    if (r < 0 || r > n) return 0;
    return (ll)fact[n] * invfact[r] % MOD * invfact[n-r] % MOD;
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    int n; ll K;
    cin >> n >> K;
    if (K >= n) {
        cout << 0 << endl;
        return 0;
    }
    precompute(250000);
    if (K == 0) {
        cout << fact[n] << endl;
        return 0;
    }
    ll ans = 0;
    int limit = n - (int)K;
    for (int i = limit, s = 1; i >= 1; --i, s = (MOD - s) % MOD) {
        ll term = C(n, i);
        term = term * modpow(i, n) % MOD;
        term = term * s % MOD;
        term = term * C(n - i, (int)K) % MOD;
        ans = (ans + term) % MOD;
    }
    ans = (ans * 2) % MOD;
    cout << ans << endl;
    return 0;
}
